AutomationAction.description: One action the run carried out, as it happened.

files.description: upload: the files attached, relative to the project
files.title: Files

navigated_from.description: The path the page left in that navigation (the export waits to leave it when the new path holds an id made for the run)
navigated_from.title: Navigated From

navigated_to.description: The path a navigation the action caused ended on (the export waits for it)
navigated_to.title: Navigated To

option.description: select: the option's label or value as chosen (a template when it is the typed value)
option.title: Option

option_exact.description: select (custom drop-down): whether the option's name matched exactly
option_exact.title: Option Exact

option_role.description: select (custom drop-down): the role of the option clicked
option_role.title: Option Role

saved_as.description: download: the file's name as the run saved it
saved_as.title: Saved As

select_by.description: select: how the option was chosen
select_by.title: Select By

typed.description: select (custom drop-down): the value was typed into it before the option was clicked
typed.title: Typed

url.description: navigate: the address, relative to base_url when it is under it
url.title: Url

value.description: fill/select: the value as a template; {{name}} names an entry of the spec's data. upload: the file names, " | " between several
value.title: Value

AutomationAction.title: AutomationAction

AutomationCheck.description: One check of a step and how it was verified.

expected.description: The expected text, URL or outcome as a template
expected.title: Expected

file_check.description: file: what is checked in the run's latest downloaded file
file_check.title: File Check

observed.description: Judged checks: literal evidence of the page it was judged on (title and address)
observed.title: Observed

read.description: field: how its value is read: an input's value, a native drop-down's chosen option label, or the text a custom drop-down shows
read.title: Read

subject.description: file column: the column; file json: the JSON path; field: the field's name in the step
subject.title: Subject

target.description: element_visible and field: the element; text checks: the frames the text is in (when not in the top document)

where.description: file column: the row checked, as "<column> = <value>" (None: every row)
where.title: Where

AutomationCheck.title: AutomationCheck

AutomationData.description: Where a ``{{name}}`` value comes from: a plain value of the case, a secret (an environment variable), a built-in, or a value a step saved.

env.description: secret: the environment variable holding it
env.title: Env

step.description: saved: the step that saves it
step.title: Step

value.description: value: the case's value as written (may hold built-in placeholders)
value.title: Value

AutomationData.title: AutomationData

AutomationSpec.description: A run as framework-neutral automation: the steps that ran, in order, with their data references.

app.description: Native app runs: the app and device (MobileApp); exported as Appium code, not Playwright code
app.title: App

appium.description: Native app runs: the Appium server or device cloud hub the run used, and the environment variables holding the cloud's credentials (never their values)
appium.title: Appium

browser_name.description: The browser the run used: chromium (when unset), chrome, msedge, firefox or webkit
browser_name.title: Browser Name

browser_options.description: The Playwright launch and context options the run used (secrets by variable name)

device.description: Mobile web emulation: the Playwright device profile the run used
device.title: Device

AutomationSpec.title: AutomationSpec

AutomationStep.description: What one step did: its actions in order, then its checks (browser steps), or its API, SQL, quality or security payload.

api.description: api steps: the request and checks as executed (ApiCall, placeholders kept)
api.title: Api

device.description: mobile steps: the actions done on the device, in order (their checks are in checks)
device.title: Device

payload_source.description: api/sql/quality/security: written in the case, or read from the step's text by the model
payload_source.title: Payload Source

quality.description: quality steps: the check as executed (QualityCheck)
quality.title: Quality

security.description: security steps: the scan as executed (SecurityScan)
security.title: Security

sql.description: sql steps: the query and checks as executed (SqlCall, placeholders kept)
sql.title: Sql

AutomationStep.title: AutomationStep

BrowserOptions.description: Playwright launch and context options for a web run (Playwright's names).

extra_http_headers.description: headers sent with every request; a value may be {"secret": "ENV_VAR"}
extra_http_headers.title: Extra Http Headers

headless.description: false opens a visible window (the run's --headed always does)
headless.title: Headless

permissions.description: permissions granted to every page, e.g. geolocation, notifications, clipboard-read
permissions.title: Permissions

record_video.description: record a video of the run into its evidence folder (on unless set to false)
record_video.title: Record Video

slow_mo.description: milliseconds Playwright waits after each action
slow_mo.title: Slow Mo

storage_state.description: auth state: a JSON file inside the project (cookies and local storage), as saved by Playwright's storage_state()
storage_state.title: Storage State

timezone_id.description: an IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin
timezone_id.title: Timezone Id

BrowserOptions.title: BrowserOptions

CostInfo.description: Model usage for the run: local-model tokens, and the hosted decision cost in USD (None when nothing was billed).

decision_tokens_est.description: Estimated prompt tokens sent to JEV (or a Clef server) for decisions; they report cost, not exact counts. None when none was asked.
decision_tokens_est.title: Decision Tokens Est

CostInfo.title: CostInfo

DeviceAction.description: One action a native app step carried out on the device, as it happened.

at_center.description: tap: the screen had not changed when the run looked again after the tap, so the run also tapped where the element was drawn
at_center.title: At Center

direction.description: scroll: what came into view; swipe: the way the finger moved
direction.title: Direction

value.description: type: the text as a template; {{name}} names an entry of the spec's data
value.title: Value

DeviceAction.title: DeviceAction

DeviceElement.description: The native app element an action used: its role and name as read from the screen, its locators (best first) and where it was drawn.

bounds.description: x, y, width, height in screen pixels
bounds.title: Bounds

kind.description: Its class (Android) or element type (iOS), e.g. EditText, Button
kind.title: Kind

screen.description: The screen's width and height in pixels, when the page source says
screen.title: Screen

DeviceElement.title: DeviceElement

DeviceLocator.description: One way to find a native app element again (an Appium locator), with what it matched on the screen when the run used it.

count.description: Elements it matched on the screen's page source
count.title: Count

inner.description: It finds a text drawn inside the element (a list row named after its title); a tap on it reaches the element
inner.title: Inner

position.description: Which of those (in document order) was the element
position.title: Position

DeviceLocator.title: DeviceLocator

DiffClassification.description: A decision engine's reading of a visual diff: intended change, layout break or content change.
DiffClassification.title: DiffClassification

EngineInfo.description:
Which engines produced the result.

``mode`` is ``pure`` (the local model does everything), ``hybrid`` (JEV decides,
the local model does the rest) or ``test`` (a model-free test decider).
EngineInfo.title: EngineInfo

EvidencePaths.description:
Locations of run artifacts, relative to the run directory.

``junit`` (JUnit XML of the steps), ``console`` (``console.jsonl``: the page's console
messages and errors) and ``network`` (``network.jsonl``: the page's requests and
responses, secrets and auth headers redacted) are written by every run that has them.
``video`` is the run's recording (unless ``browser_options.record_video`` is false); ``trace``, ``report_md`` and
``bundle`` are not produced by this version and stay null.
EvidencePaths.title: EvidencePaths

FailureInfo.description: Why a run failed: a model's classification (``unclassified`` when it is not sure) and a factual summary.
FailureInfo.title: FailureInfo

Finding.description: One problem on one element, with the values code measured.
Finding.title: Finding

FixSuggestion.description:
A concrete change for one finding and the result of trying it on the live page.

``changes`` is exactly what was applied for verification: CSS declarations (``css_override``,
optionally under a ``state`` pseudo-class such as ``:focus-visible``) or attribute values
(``attribute`` / ``text``). ``target_selector`` names the element changed when it is not the
finding's own element (a flex container, say), in the same frame.
FixSuggestion.title: FixSuggestion

FrameSpec.description: One iframe on the way to an element: how to find the iframe element in its parent document.
FrameSpec.title: FrameSpec

HttpCredentials.description: HTTP authentication (basic or digest) the browser answers with.

origin.description: send them only to this origin
origin.title: Origin

password.description: {"secret": "ENV_VAR"}: the variable that holds the password

HttpCredentials.title: HttpCredentials

LocatorSpec.description: One way to find an element, with the number of elements it matched on the live page (exported locators matched one).

attribute.description: test_id: the attribute holding it (data-testid, data-test, data-qa, data-cy ...)
attribute.title: Attribute

name.description: role: the accessible name (None: the role alone)
name.title: Name

selectors.description: css: one selector per tree, each inside the shadow root of the element the previous one matched
selectors.title: Selectors

value.description: test id, label, placeholder, text, alt text or title
value.title: Value

LocatorSpec.title: LocatorSpec

PlanSummary.description: The plan of a run in numbers (``RunResult.plan``); the plan itself is ``plan.json`` beside ``run.json``.

coverage_gaps.description: Source steps the coverage audit still found not covered after the repair
coverage_gaps.title: Coverage Gaps

file.description: The plan's file, relative to the run directory
file.title: File

recoveries.description: Unmet criteria that drove a recovery
recoveries.title: Recoveries

PlanSummary.title: PlanSummary

bypass.description: comma-separated hosts that skip the proxy, e.g. .example.com,localhost
bypass.title: Bypass

QualityCounts.description: Distinct findings (by id) per impact, and totals of findings, fixes, verified fixes and audited pages.
QualityCounts.title: QualityCounts

QualityPage.description: One audit of one page state: by a quality step (``source: step``) or by the run's a11y/visual option (``run``).

not_scanned.description: Frames that could not be scanned (cross-origin)
not_scanned.title: Not Scanned

step.description: The step that ran the check, or after which the page was audited
step.title: Step

QualityPage.title: QualityPage

QualitySection.description:
Every page audited in a run with its findings and verified fixes, and totals by impact.

Run-level audits (the run's ``a11y``/``visual`` options) fail the run only when ``fail_on`` is set
and a finding is at or above it; quality steps fail their own step.

counts.description: Computed from pages; any value given is replaced

QualitySection.title: QualitySection

QualityVisual.description: A visual comparison with a baseline: the pixel gate, the style deltas, the images and the decider's reading.

created.description: The baseline did not exist and was created from this page
created.title: Created

missing.description: Key elements no longer on the page
missing.title: Missing

note.description: Why a difference was not classified (no decider that can see screenshots, no answer)
note.title: Note

QualityVisual.title: QualityVisual

Secret.description: A value read from the named environment variable at run time; never the value itself.
Secret.title: Secret

SecurityCounts.description: Findings per severity, and their total.
SecurityCounts.title: SecurityCounts

SecurityFinding.description: One match of a scanner template on the app (text already redacted).

extracted.description: Values the template extracted (first few, clipped)
extracted.title: Extracted

matched_at.description: The URL (or host) the template matched
matched_at.title: Matched At

matcher.description: Which of the template's matchers fired
matcher.title: Matcher

SecurityFinding.title: SecurityFinding

SecurityScanResult.description: One scan: what was scanned with which tags, its findings, and the ones at or above ``fail_on``.

counts.description: Computed from findings; any value given is replaced

error.description: Why the scan did not finish (scanner missing, refused target, timeout)
error.title: Error

step.description: The step that ran the scan (null for `hercules scan`)
step.title: Step

target.description: The URL scanned, or the OpenAPI spec (relative to the project) whose operations were scanned
target.title: Target

SecurityScanResult.title: SecurityScanResult

SecuritySection.description: Every security scan of a run, and the findings per severity over all of them.

counts.description: Computed from scans; any value given is replaced

SecuritySection.title: SecuritySection

StepResult.description: Outcome of one step; ``index`` is the 1-based position in the case.

notes.description: What the run changed about the step: its order, a value re-entered the way a field asks for it
notes.title: Notes

sequence.description: When the step ran, 1-based, when that differs from its index (a field it depends on ran first); null when it ran in the written order
sequence.title: Sequence

StepResult.title: StepResult

StyleDelta.description: One computed-style (or box) property of a key element that differs from its baseline value.
StyleDelta.title: StyleDelta

TargetSpec.description: The element an action used: its role and name as perceived, the frames it is in, and its unique locators (best first).

checked.description: Candidates evaluated on the live page
checked.title: Checked

locator.description: The preferred locator; None when no candidate matched only this element

TargetSpec.title: TargetSpec

description: Result of one run, returned by the API and MCP tools and stored as ``run.json``.

plan.description: The run's plan in numbers (criteria results, amendments, lint); the plan itself is plan.json beside run.json

security.description: The run's security scans (security steps) and their findings
